messages.content: Find a picnic spot in Miami.

function.name: local_fauna
function.description: Get information about fauna in a specified region. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The region or area to find information about.

species_type.description: Type of species e.g birds, mammals etc. for detailed information.

migration_season.description: Season when fauna migrate e.g spring, winter, none. Default is none.

message.content:
Here are a few great picnic spots in Miami where you can relax, enjoy the outdoors, and have a nice meal: | Spot | Description | Highlights | |------|-------------|------------| | **South Pointe Park** | Located at the southern tip of Miami Beach, this park offers scenic views of the ocean, piers, and cruise ships. | • Picnic tables with ocean views
• Walking paths and playgrounds
• Dog-friendly areas | | **Bill Baggs Cape Florida State Park** | A historic lighthouse and beautiful beach setting on Key Biscayne. | • Lush pine trees and sandy beach
• Picnic shelters and grills
• Lighthouse tours | | **Lummus Park** | A beachfront park along Ocean Drive, perfect for a casual picnic with a view of the Atlantic. | • Wide open lawns and benches
• Easy access to the beach
• Nearby cafés for snacks | | **Everglades Holiday Park** | For a more nature‑centric experience, this park offers airboat tours and wildlife viewing. | • Picnic areas with grills
• Guided airboat tours
• Wildlife observation | | **Miami Beach Botanical Garden** | A tranquil oasis in the heart of South Beach. | • Beautiful gardens and shaded areas
• Picnic tables and benches
• Cultural events and art installations | **Tips for a Great Picnic:** - Check the weather forecast and bring sunscreen, hats, and water. - If you’re bringing food, consider a cooler with ice packs to keep perishables fresh. - Some parks allow pets, but always check local regulations and leash requirements. - Bring a blanket or portable chairs for added comfort. Enjoy your picnic in Miami!
